scope.scene: chat, assigned default for clips without real app metadata; not scene routing acceptance
scope.architecture: Formatter-v3 actual prompt, visible production-cleanup snapshot source, no OCR/memory/reference. Deterministic producer has zero context candidates; no invented LLM selection object or new selector generation. Exact native Qwen3.5-2B Q4/runtime/Metal99/cacheoff/greedy/ctx4096/output256.
scope.evaluation: Diagnostic only; no promotion regardless of scores. All120 source/output pairs personally reviewed for source-meaning fidelity, language preservation, unsupported facts/names/numbers/negation/modalities and naturalness separately. Grammatical punctuation/inflection edits allowed; corrupt/partial sources are not a licence to invent hidden missing content. Source-faithful nonsense is not automatically natural/usable. Published reference and audio are never passed to model. Retain refusals/empty/truncated/unchanged failures in denominators.
scope.scope: 120 historical natural read-speech ASR sources with previous lineage/audio hash audit; source text exposed in earlier text-only review, first new candidate inference. Not new heldout/spontaneous dictation, true OCR/ASR pairing, independent human quality or speech-reference recovery. Does not consume frozen synthetic fresh24 or waive its full gate.
scope.performance: Single formatter request external/native timings and post-response sampled workerRSS only. No full2-stage/concurrentASR/native preview/insertion/peak whole-app/minimum AppleSilicon16GB acceptance. M4/32GB only. No4B/olderQwen/Granite/Q8 inference.
